_comment: Sandbox cell OpenCode config (see specs/04-worker-cell.md). Delivered via OPENCODE_CONFIG env. Auth from attached opencode-go provider (OPENCODE_API_KEY, placeholder-masked) — no keys here. permission:allow + `opencode run --auto` so nothing (question/doom_loop/external_directory default to ask) can stall a headless cell waiting on input; OpenShell policy is the real perimeter, and explicit deny rules would still be enforced. Proven live 2026-09-17: headless `opencode --model opencode-go/muse-spark-1.3-contributor run` self-identifies in-cell after models.opencode.ai allowlist. Adjust IDs to `opencode models` output; per-run override via --model.
